summary: Unit tests (SecretRotationValidator.Tests.ps1) are solid and cover all main functions, status classifications, error handling, and both output formats. However, Act.Tests.ps1 references fixture files (case-mixed.json, case-all-ok.json, case-all-expired.json) and a .actrc file that are not provided, making the end-to-end tests incomplete. The workflow structure tests are comprehensive. Missing edge cases: timezone handling, very large/small policy days, RequiredBy field optionality, dependency availability checks (act, docker, powershell-yaml module). The test suite shows good design principles and strong unit test coverage, but the integration tests are compromised by missing supporting files and incomplete error handling for the test infrastructure itself.
